mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite high unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong but payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is weak, it indicates an unsustainable economic expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive if GDPC1 and PAYEMS growth rates are positively correlated (correlation > 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during a late-cycle expansion signals supply chain constraints or reduced business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive if INDPRO continues to grow despite being in a late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) is strong but the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is high, it indicates an imbalanced economic recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive if RSAFS growth and UNRATE reductions are positively correlated (correlation > 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: A strong rebound in GDP growth (GDPC1) following an economic shock signals a robust recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain negative if GDPC1 growth is strong but other economic indicators (e.g., UNRATE) remain weak.
